body_lead: A key highlight of Odisha’s participation is its strategic collaboration with Sarvam AI, aimed at building sovereign AI capabilities with a special focus on population-scale Odia-language AI applications Bhubaneswar: The Odisha government is projecting itself as one of India’s early movers in artificial intelligence (AI) adoption by showcasing its policy vision, institutional preparedness and real-world deployments at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, being held at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi from February 16 to 20.
